title.zh: Cloudflare让3个AI接力处理理赔：自测快3.2倍，成本降49%
title.en: Cloudflare让3个AI接力处理理赔：自测快3.2倍，成本降49%

current_state.zh: Cloudflare previewed Clairic on Workers AI, a non-autoregressive model that extracts fields, computes values and returns confidence scores directly, which in a claims-processing demo combined with the Clef decision model ran 3.2x faster and cut costs 49% versus routing everything through a single LLM.
